Eccleshall FC continued their impressive run of form on Saturday afternoon, securing a convincing 5–0 victory over Shawbury United at the Stoke Signage Stadium.

Charlie Padania and Nicky Parker both grabbed a brace, while Levi Hunter added his name to the scoresheet to complete the five-goal victory.
